calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-27-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of petitioner, and Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Clifford Y. Wang, Esq. appeared with petitioner Sio Mui Lao, who was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors Ka Hou Sin and Ka Weng Sin.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Clifford Y. Wang, Esq. was placed under oath and served as Cantonese speaking interpreter for petitioner.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Kitty SioMui Lao.

Furthermore, the Court grants the petition to Change the Names of the two Minors to: Oscar KaHou Sin and Karen KaWeng Sin.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
